## What does this improve?

Briefly explain the problem and the change. Link an issue if there is one.

## How did you check it?

List commands/results, screenshots for UI changes, or explain what could not run.

- [ ] The change has a focused scope.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks are described above.
- [ ] Mathematical changes include exact sources, coefficients, degrees, and conventions (or are not applicable).
- [ ] Missing data and human-review status remain honest.
- [ ] Upstream attribution is preserved; no private data or copied material with unclear permission was added.

AI assistance is welcome; mention it where useful and distinguish checks actually
performed from suggestions. Please do not mark agent review as human acceptance.
